title: Musk's Grok Bot Adds Dedicated Email AI Assistant, Marking a New Stage in Independent Communication

content_html:
Elon Musk's SpaceX AI company has recently announced the launch of a dedicated email feature for its persistent AI assistant, Grok Bot. This new feature marks the gradual shift of AI assistants from purely conversational roles to having their own independent online identities and contact points.

Comprehensive Expansion of Multi-functional Application Scenarios

According to the official announcement, the newly assigned email addresses all end with a specific domain suffix. Users can not only customize personalized prefixes but also initiate the claiming process through simple chat commands. This dedicated email can help users register for various online services, communicate with merchants on their behalf, and manage daily schedules, thereby significantly improving the efficiency of multi-step back-end tasks.

Ongoing Upgrades of Cloud-based Persistent Intelligent Agents

As a persistent intelligent agent running on cloud-based virtual machines, Grok Bot has previously deeply integrated X platform's content monitoring features and has the practical ability to help users view orders and manage product inventories. With the addition of the dedicated email feature, it can seamlessly integrate into more complex email workflows as an independent entity, opening up more possibilities for future automation scenarios.
